name: Dino Alphabet 恐龙字母卡组
description: 26 letters A-Z with a dinosaur per letter (ages 3-6); companion web tool provides an A-Z letter wall (each cell in that dinosaur's own color, click to hear "A for …" and jump) + big-letter cards with phonics, sample word, read-aloud. 26个字母各配一只恐龙（3-6岁）；配套小工具提供 A-Z 字母墙（每格是这只恐龙自己的颜色，点格子读「A for …」并跳卡）+ 大字母卡片（phonics/例词/中英恐龙名/朗读）。
author: Alfred Long
